lines: Priyanka Manish Sharma, Promoter Group, holds 57,000 shares, valued at up to ₹7.71 crore at offer price, shares not cash.
Their pre-Offer shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, so the trigger is not fresh.
Family link: their name contains Manish Sharma, which may matter for coordinating the relationship.
Confidence is medium: holdings appear in one section only, and seller-table proceeds and gain are not applicable.
